title: RuleFile
description:
One lint rule. Store each rule in `<rules_dir>/<id>.toml`.

Exactly one matcher is required: `query`, `regex` or `path_only`.

compat.description: Names this rule has in other linters, for suppression-comment compatibility.

description.description: Optional longer explanation: why the rule exists and how to fix findings.

exclude.description: Skip files matching these root-relative globs. Directory globs also exclude their contents.

id.description: Unique id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Must equal the file name without `.toml`.

if_file.description: Only lint files where this condition matches.

include.description: Only lint files matching these root-relative globs (default: every configured file).

limit.description: Limit findings per file. Applied before suppression comments.

mask.description:
For `regex`: blank or remove syntax (strings, comments, ...) before matching.
One mask, or a list of masks applied in order (later masks win).

path_only.description: Report one finding at line 1 of every selected file. Use with `include`/`exclude`.

prefilter.description:
For `regex`: an optional fast regex (no look-around) checked on the raw, unmasked line
(`scope = "line"`) or file before masking and `regex` run. Purely an optimization:
it must match the raw text whenever `regex` matches the masked text.

query.description:
Tree-sitter query over the Elixir syntax tree. Each `@finding` capture is one finding.
Run `fino tree FILE` to see node kinds and field names.

regex.description: Regular expression (Rust syntax plus look-around). Each match is one finding.

scope.description: For `regex`: match the whole file (default) or each line separately.

severity.description: New `error` findings fail checks; `warning` findings are only reported.

skip_inside.description:
Drop findings located inside nodes captured by this tree-sitter query
(captures not starting with `_`), e.g. everything inside `quote do ... end`.

skip_lines.description: Drop findings on lines matching this condition.

tests.description: Examples run by `fino test`. Include at least one finding and one clean case.

unless_file.description: Skip files where this condition matches.

Condition.description: A condition matches when any given matcher matches. At least one is required.

query.description: Tree-sitter query. For `skip_lines`, lines where a non-`_` capture starts match.

regex.description: Regex. For `skip_lines` it runs on each (masked) line; otherwise on the raw file.

oneOf.description: Keep only the first finding in each file.

Mask.description:
Replace syntax content before regex matching. Newlines are always kept, so line
numbers do not change. Delimiters (quotes, `~r/`, ...) are kept.

fill_blank_lines.description: Also put `with` on empty lines inside masked content, so they no longer look blank.

query.description:
Tree-sitter query selecting more nodes to mask (captures not starting with `_`).
Quoted nodes (strings, sigils, ...) mask their content; other nodes mask entirely.

with.description: Replacement for each masked byte: one ASCII character, or "" to remove the content.

oneOf.description: Content of sigils such as ~r/.../ and ~s(...).
Content of quoted atoms (:"a b") and quoted keyword keys ("a b": 1).

credo.description: Fully qualified Credo check name, e.g. `Credo.Check.Warning.IoInspect`.

RuleTest.description: An example source file and the lines where the rule must report findings.

expect.description:
One-based line of every expected finding, repeated for several findings on one line.
Use `[]` for a clean example.

path.description: Path the example pretends to have; matters for `include`/`exclude`.
